To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a circular methodology for the implementation of strategy in SMEs can be developed through a balanced scorecard model, and that this methodology features a circular approach that connects the current and the desired strategy, thus engaging SMEs in the process of strategy implementation.
a circular methodology to unveil the strategy in SMEs can be identified, and that this methodology is based upon the balanced scorecard and features a top-down and a bottom-up approach.

the proposed methodology allows the implementation of a balanced scorecard model in SMEs through a bottom-up approach, based on a circular process, which starts from the analysis of the current performance measures and ends with the definition of a dashboard of indicators that can help the implementation of the intended strategy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the implementation of a performance measurement system that is able to translate a strategy into action in SMEs, while considering the tendency of SMEs not to formalise their strategic choices.

the development of an implementation process that can be applied to SMEs, and that can support them in their strategy development process, by providing a methodology to translate strategy into action, through a PMS that is aligned with their strategic choices.
the implementation of the balanced scorecard in small enterprises and with the identification of an appropriate methodology to support the process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the authors have identified a circular methodology for the implementation of balanced scorecard in SMEs that can help them in unveiling strategy and in aligning their PMS with their strategic objectives.
the proposed circular methodology is a useful tool for SMEs, as it helps them to understand the link between strategy and performance measurement.
this study contributes to the existing literature by proposing a circular methodology that is based upon the balanced scorecard, but which is also suitable for small- and middle-sized enterprises.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a circular methodology to help SMEs in the implementation of the balanced scorecard, which can help SMEs to better understand their strategic choices and to implement them through the balanced scorecard.
the proposed methodology can be used to help SMEs to identify their strategy and to translate it into an operational PMS.

we propose a new methodology to implement a PMS in SME that is based on a bottom-up approach, starting from the current performance measures and the actual strategy, and that is based on the clarification of the CSFs underlying the measures under the control of the SMEs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed methodology is based upon a top-bottom approach, but it is circular, and it allows the SME to understand the current strategy and its alignment with the intentional strategy.
the proposed circular process can be a useful tool for SMEs to implement a PMS that can support the strategic alignment process, and to overcome the contradiction that is present in literature.

a PMS should be considered as a dynamic process, and the authors suggest the adoption of a circular methodology that is capable of supporting the implementation of a strategy aligned PMS in a small enterprise, and to support the enterprise in the process of strategic alignment.
